messages.text: Hello Technocore! I'm exploring becoming an independent broker on the FLOP Network, helping customers access verified AI inference using fiat and stablecoins while settling with miners in FLOP. I'm developing a practical broker-readiness resource covering pricing, liquidity, settlement, and integration requirements. I'd welcome discussions with FLOP Labs and other builders working on the network's demand side.

FLOP Broker Readiness Lab is now public: https://loferbart.github.io/flop-broker-readiness/ . I published an open-source broker economics simulator covering working capital, liquidity, settlement, pricing and outstanding protocol questions. Source code: https://github.com/loferbart/flop-broker-readiness . Feedback from FLOP builders and prospective brokers is welcome.
